sources.title: Paper Engineering: Fold, Pull, Pop and Turn
sources.creator: Smithsonian Libraries
sources.rights: Copyright not cleared for embedded reference images; source link only
sources.medium: movable paper books, hinge and tab mechanisms

analysis.construction: Book leaves pivot about a spine, with mechanisms attached to a moving paper substrate rather than floating overlays.
analysis.material: Paper leaf stays opaque while revealing another page beneath.
analysis.microdetail: Crease and attachment points are structural; show a visible book gutter and distinct stock verso.
analysis.light: Leaf edge casts a directional separation shadow. Stage light must remain consistent across the edit.

crops.observation: Source mechanism taxonomy supports hinge-first construction, not an alpha blend.
crops.implementation_rule: Keep an independent rigid page plane attached at a fixed spine; never fade the old scene.

sources.title: The Dark is Rising
sources.creator: Su Blackwell
sources.rights: Artist and gallery rights reserved; image linked only for visual study
sources.medium: sculpted cut book landscape with tree branches and interior light

analysis.construction: An intact book cradle supports multi-depth trees and house shapes emerging from its pages. The paper leaves remain materially distinct from the cut motifs.
analysis.material: Visible physical sheet thickness, dark edges and independent relief cast occlusion shadows.
analysis.microdetail: Branch topology, opening windows, leaf edges and fine text surface distinguish craft from generic vector solids.
analysis.light: The illuminated small house sets a focus, while tree depth remains readable.

crops.observation: Page edges converge into a central physical binding; diorama sits on the sheet rather than passing through it.
crops.implementation_rule: Model a fixed gutter, show a separate light/dark leaf face, and keep the rendered paper art attached to the moving face.

sources.title: Pop-Up Hand Shadow Book
sources.creator: Helen Hiebert
sources.rights: Artist rights retained; image linked only, no pixel tracing
sources.medium: book pages with dimensional hand cutouts, directed shadows

analysis.construction: Book panels are connected by dark bindings; raised sculpted hand pages cast intentional screen shadow.
analysis.material: Separate white page stocks and backboard; old/new art should remain printed onto separate solid substrates.
analysis.microdetail: Fine cut finger silhouettes and a distinct black page crease provide identity.
analysis.light: Handheld lamp produces localized shadows, showing depth from genuine paper openings.

crops.observation: Multi-panel page opening is held by visible dark fabric or paper spine, a real fixed axis.
crops.implementation_rule: Book-spine location stays anchored across the whole animation, independent of page rotation.

sources.title: 360-degree architectural pop-up books
sources.creator: Yusuke Oono (via Core77)
sources.rights: Artwork rights not granted, source link for study only
sources.view: frontal photograph of intricately cut paper

analysis.construction: A physical spine supports multiple continuous cut silhouette sheets; the page mechanism is not an image wipe.
analysis.material: Exposed paper relief shadows and cut edge contours.
analysis.microdetail: Tree foliage, animals, building facades and figure silhouettes contribute many layered apertures.
analysis.light: Warm transmission backlight separates stock depths.

feature_targets.source_observation: A leaf pivots around a fixed binding and carries its own original illustration; pages do not dissolve into each other.
feature_targets.geometry_rule: outgoing paper SVG is an entire painted card, rotated about the fixed CSS 3D gutter; incoming independent page is below.

feature_targets.source_observation: Paper relief remains separate from the book leaf and creates contact shadows; fine cuts and window apertures remain intact.
feature_targets.geometry_rule: render original complex PAPER1 scene on the leaf without rasterization; pass the second scene directly beneath; keep shadows on outer leaf.

feature_targets.source_observation: A page-turn reads by a single hinge; motion direction follows a physical page rather than a mirrored image wipe.
feature_targets.geometry_rule: direction left-to-right pivots about right edge, reverse uses left; projected leaf 0→180 degrees with full adjacent scene at seam.
feature_targets.test_view: two-aspect and both direction seams 239/240 and 479/480

notes.rights: No third-party pixel data copied or stored. Source preview URLs are metadata only.
